title: Top Things To Do In Pasadena: July 23rd through 29th - NewsBreak
text:
July 25th through 27th Pasadena Bead & Design Show The Pasadena Bead and Design show at the Pasadena Convention Center features over 300 artisan exhibits and workshops with a variety of beads, gems, artisan materials, clothing, and jewelry. It offers attendees creative inspiration and opportunities to discover unique gifts.
Buy Tickets July 25th through August 8th Dine LA Restaurant Week Experience the culinary diversity of Pasadena and LA with Dine LA Restaurant Week. No tickets needed, just dine at participating eateries with special lunch and dinner menus ranging from $15 to $65+. Visit Dine LA for the latest list of places. Each reservation supports wildfire relief as LA Tourism will donate $5 per reservation made to The American Red Cross with a match from Banc of California.
Learn More July 25th Sunset Music Series The Sunset Music Series at Kidspace Children's Museum invites families to enjoy extended evening hours filled with live multicultural music, interactive dance, art-making, and sensory adventures in a relaxed outdoor setting. With performances in the Stone Hollow Amphitheater and engaging science-art experiences like the Wired for Wonder maze, it's a great way to kick off your weekend under the stars.
Buy Tickets July 26th Haunted Pasadena Pasadena Walking Tours presents Haunted Pasadena, a chilling two-hour walking tour through the city’s most eerie sites—from dim alleyways and hidden courtyards to historic theaters and mortuary grounds—bringing to light restless spirits, unsolved mysteries, and scandalous events from Pasadena’s past.
Buy Tickets July 27th East Washington Village Walking Tour Pasadena Walking Tours introduces the East Washington Village Walking Tour, a guided 1.4-mile stroll through this historic, multiethnic neighborhood that straddles Pasadena and Altadena, showcasing charming local businesses and residential areas tied to historic districts like Bungalow Heaven and Washington Square.
